name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for storm-damaged drywall replacement in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for storm-damaged drywall replacement in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor in the Bay Area for storm-damaged drywall replacement, look for licensed and insured professionals with experience in water damage restoration. Check their reviews and ask for references. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining all work, materials, and timelines. Confirm they are familiar with local building codes and can assist with insurance claims. Prioritize clear communication and a contractor who explains the process thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with water damage experience, good reviews, detailed estimates, and local code knowledge.
